scripts.build:wrangler-dev: pnpm run --dir apps/worker build && pnpm run --dir apps/web build
scripts.build: turbo run build && pnpm exec tsx scripts/verify-server-bundle.ts && cp -r apps/docs/.vitepress/dist apps/web/dist/client/docs
scripts.logo: pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-logos.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-favicon.ts
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.oxlint.json scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json && oxfmt --check scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.lint:fix: turbo run lint:fix && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.oxlint.json --fix scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json && oxfmt --write scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format: turbo run format && oxfmt --write scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx scripts/deploy.ts
